rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese way to describe someone's habitual tendency to say little.

example.english: Their taciturnity does not stop them from being reliable at work.
example.traditional: 佢平時唔多出聲，但做嘢好可靠。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ping4 si4 m4 do1 ceot1 seng1 daan6 zou6 je5 hou2 ho2 kaau3
